messages:
tyler: heads-up: we just got a burn-rate alert for model-api-prod, spike to ~11.8x over 10m. alert: https://grafana.internal.redwood/alert/4567
observability-bot: Alert fired: slo.burnrate.model-api-prod > 10x (10m). fired_at: 2026-06-03T09:42:02Z. alert_id: slo-burn-456
olivia: assigning to oncall and observability. can someone grab deploy timeline + traces?
aseem: traces: https://jaeger.redwood/trace?service=model-api-prod&start=2026-06-03T09:30&end=2026-06-03T09:45. quick look shows increased latency to prefix-cache at ~09:37
maria: checking infra: node-gpu-02 had OOM kill events at 09:36; kube events: `Evicted` for a few pods around that time
tyler: deploys: ci-bot reports canary deploy commit def456 at 09:35. logs show a temporary surge of 2xx retries from traffic-generator: `Retrying request, attempt=3`
olivia: tailing prod logs: `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/model-api-prod -c inference --since=25m | grep -i retry` -> ~55 retry log lines across 4 pods
aseem: traces show backpressure from cache -> cascade to GPU queuing. inference durations stayed ~stable per-model, but queue wait grew from 20ms -> 450ms at peak
sre-oncall: Runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/slo-burn-rate. Steps: check replica counts, pod restarts, upstream error metrics, and consider aborting canary if correlated with deploy
maria: recommended immediate mitigations: 1) drain node-gpu-02 2) scale up cache read replicas 3) reduce canary weight to 10%
tyler: opened MR to change alert tuning + add correlate condition for upstream_cache_errors: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/-/merge_requests/812. Draft rule:

- alert: SLOBurnRate_model_api_prod
  expr: increase(slo_burn_rate_model_api_prod[6m]) > 7
  for: 3m
  labels: {severity: warning}
  annotations: {runbook: "https://runbooks.internal/slo-burn-rate", pager: "#oncall"}

olivia: I like tightening for short-term noise. Suggest also adding a parallel alert for `upstream_cache_errors > 0` with low noise suppression so we detect root cause
aseem: adding grafana panel for upstream_cache_errors and cache latency to the model-api-prod dashboard, will PR dashboard change in 1hr
sre-oncall: if we see OOMs again, please capture `kubectl describe pod` and node dmesg. Also add `oom_kill` metric to node alerts
maria: created incident IR-2026-198 and linked MR + dashboard ticket. assignees: olivia, aseem, tyler
observability-bot: Incident IR-2026-198 created by tyler. severity: P3. assignees: olivia, aseem
tyler: follow-ups: 1) temp alert rule change MR 812 2) add cache metrics to dashboard 3) review canary traffic shaping. scheduling retrospective for 2026-06-04 16:00 on monitoring board
olivia: noted. thanks all. :thumbsup:
